top.en: In the 2022 World Championship, this person was treated as a toilet by every ADC in the tournament. Redmi explicitly named him as the No. 1 seed, but he only made it to the quarterfinals without any heart; in the semifinals, he got crushed by JieDan (Jie), creating the largest ADC gap in history. He was mocked face-to-face by Xiao LuBu (Xiao), so you all know why JDG didn't want to play against our bot lane. In three games, Elu was dominated by Luna; in the final game, even with Jhin and Karma begging him not to lose the laning phase, he still got line-killed repeatedly. Even when top-tier junglers like 9G (Jiejie) and ZhuMei (Zhuo) came down to help, he handed them over immediately, and Xiao LuBu still got line-killed. This wasted JDG's peak upper-mid-jungle lineup that year—JDG could have contended for the championship with any other ADC, even one who dared to fight back. Why does everyone love Jiaqi while you only bring despair? Since 2022, LPL has suffered greatly from a lack of strong ADCs. The reason JieDan plays so boldly in Worlds and T1 achieved three consecutive crowns is that our region lacks young, lane-dominating ADCs. Despair-level performance as a No. 1 seed every year is tragic. 'Hope' is the Korean forum's designated term for 'clueless player'; anyone who wants to trash talk says, 'He's Hope.' Can you retire? I'm begging you 🙏—please retire! Retire, please! Retire!!!!! I'm begging you!! Retire! Your retirement would be LPL's greatest contribution. This was your third chance; as the No. 1 seed, you went 0-3 and left at the round of 16 without winning a single game. Don't let me see you in LPL next season unless a team wants you—I'll blacken your name forever.
